body.intent: Scheduling as policy: whether accepted change sets that serve no milestone are built, and in what order relative to milestone work, is a repo rule, not daemon code; today the daemon always skips them as 'serves no milestone' (SkipNoMilestone, internal/api/daemon.go:1159). The shipped default builds them after milestone work, oldest accepted first, so bug fixes, small features and repos with no milestones at all ship. A request's plan links a milestone only when one fits or the request names one with --milestone (relaxes the landed fix 01M6JDMJ, which made every request's plan serve a milestone). Follows decision workflows-are-the-rules (PR #353): every rule is workflow policy the owner defines, Rhiza ships defaults and enforces only references between nodes.
